scope: Installed version recommendations and actual cheap-probe differences; no new inference

actualProbeOverrides.input: single front isolated flat guide; rear/context retained, not conditioned

comparison.documented: 12 for each stage; Mac generate.py leaves override unset
comparison.mechanism: Fewer flow integration steps; does not change mesh extraction or normal handling

comparison.documented: Mac CLI default512; installed upstream config default1024_cascade; supports512/1024/1536
comparison.mechanism: Mac documented starting resolution, not unsupported mode; cascade not automatically justified

comparison.documented: Checkpoint config starts256, pipeline calls set_resolution(requested res)
comparison.mechanism: Do not misreport decoded resolution as256

comparison.documented: Mac explicitly imports pure-Python o_voxel_override_convert to avoid native segfaults
comparison.actual: Same pinned override selected by decoder source
comparison.mechanism: Learned softplus quad_lerp is supplied; split_weight=None normal-alignment heuristic is not the active inference branch

comparison.documented: Mac mesh.fill_holes returns immediately; known small holes limitation
comparison.actual: No hole filling, cleanup or reduction
comparison.mechanism: Native boundaries retained; additional steps do not enable hole repair

comparison.documented: Mac CLI pre-simplifies to about200k faces and bakes1024 texture; upstream example remeshes, targets1m faces and4096 texture
comparison.actual: No simplify/remesh/UV bake; raw mesh smooth-shaded with reversed winding and CPU spatial per-vertex colours
comparison.mechanism: Raw inspection is not the documented final export/render path; its face/normal response must be qualified

comparison.documented: Mac README warns of texture-baker grid_sample fallback without mtlgemm
comparison.actual: No o_voxel texture bake used in the diagnostic or appearance film
comparison.mechanism: That specific bake fallback is not the path producing these films; this does not prove every renderer/decoder path correct

existingByteDiagnostic.observation: Lit neutral retains contours; unlit sampled colour is nearly uniform
existingByteDiagnostic.limits: Surface, normal and lighting response implicated collectively; geometry versus normals not isolated

normalWitness.meaning: Native connectivity/winding witnesses preclude assuming a coherent smooth normal field; not alone a visual-causality proof

inputVisibilityLimit: The front-only isolated flat guide does not expose rear hood geometry or detailed denim/PBR. More integration steps do not supply those missing views/details.

conditionalQualityRun.candidateDocumentedBaseline: 512, seed42, installed12step defaults, unchanged source/input pins and guards
conditionalQualityRun.expectedImprovementIfChosen: More flow integration steps can reduce sampling approximation error versus8; no validated dense-contour or hood-detail fix yet
conditionalQualityRun.reason: Material isolation identifies surface/normal/lighting involvement; twelve steps alone does not alter decoder assembly/display normal handling or add unseen hood/PBR evidence
conditionalQualityRun.nextMechanismToValidate: Native face/normal/rendering path; preserve raw arrays and label any derived display correction independently
conditionalQualityRun.guard: Fresh canonical lock; start anon<55 and combined<68GiB; stop own child at65/78GiB or1790s; no foreign eviction

limits: Installed-version analysis, not current remote HEAD or CUDA-equivalence test
No new software/weights, global environment/source edits, repair or quality run
No model-family rejection, art/fit/rig acceptance or player promotion
